notes.title: 🇬🇧 DEVELOPMENT UPDATE — GIRL.EXE.EXE
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The last month has been intense — I’ve fixed a ton of bugs, polished the experience, and gotten much closer to the final version of the game.
GIRL.EXE.EXE has grown into something much bigger than I originally imagined. And now, I'm almost ready to let it go.[/p][p]💀 This is nearly the release build. If everything goes well, the full version will be out in about 10 days.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and shared your feedback — it’s been incredibly helpful in finishing the game the right way.
If you haven’t played the demo yet — now’s a perfect time to check it out.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with me for these 3 years. The finale is coming very soon.[/p][p]— Dymchick1[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_RU"]t.me/Dymchick1_RU[/url][/p][p][url="https://t.me/Dymchick1_EN"]t.me/Dymchick1_EN[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Development Update – Progress, Achievements & More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Dymchick1 here! 🚀

Development of GIRL.EXE.EXE is in full swing! I’ve been working hard, and here’s what’s new:
✔️ Achievements added – now you’ll have more challenges to complete!
✔️ Full translation – the game page is now available in multiple languages.
✔️ Updated Steam page – added cool GIFs and improved the overall look.

The game is still in development, but if someone REALLY wants to test it, I’m open to it. Just keep in mind – it’s still a work in progress!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for your support! 💜
